title: Delta Dependency: Paralog-Based Synthetic Lethality Prediction Across Solid Tumor Types
description: Full analysis pipeline for Delta Dependency (DD) — an interpretable metric for prioritizing paralog-based synthetic lethality candidates from DepMap CRISPR screening data across 23 solid tumor types. This submission-version release includes a one-command reproducibility audit (verify_all.sh) that recomputes every quantitative claim in the accompanying manuscript from raw DepMap data, with automated claim-by-claim verification (16/16 headline claims, 10/10 regression-control claims, 31/31 tests).
